dateline: Hawthorne, CA / Boca Chica, TX — May 2002–Present
heroHeadline: Starlink Constellation Tops 10,000 Active Spacecraft — 63rd 2026 Mission Complete; Starship IFT-13 Targeting ~June 30 with Booster 20 + Ship 40; IPO Roadshow Starts June 4
heroSubtitle: 8,784 days of SpaceX milestones — Falcon 9 Starlink 10-47 launched May 25, 2026 at 08:28 UTC from SLC-40 (Cape Canaveral), deploying 29 Starlink V2 Mini satellites; B1078 28th flight recovered on ASOG — the 615th cumulative booster landing in SpaceX history. The deployment brings the Starlink constellation to 10,480+ active spacecraft in orbit, crossing the landmark 10,000 operational satellite threshold. SpaceX has now completed 63 orbital missions in 2026. Three days prior, Starship IFT-12 Block 3 (May 22 from OLP-2) achieved the world's first in-space Raptor engine relight and Ship 39 V3 splashdown in the Indian Ocean; Booster 19 was lost to an off-nominal boostback burn at ~1,450 km/h impact. IFT-13 planning targets ~June 30 with second Block 3 stack (Booster 20 + Ship 40). SpaceX IPO (Nasdaq: SPCX) management roadshow begins June 4–8, with pricing June 11 and Nasdaq debut June 12; implied valuation $1.75T–$2T on $75–80B capital raise. Retail allocation: ~30% via Robinhood, Fidelity, Charles Schwab.
